goal: Produce a proved native Lean repository whose immutable public boundary exports FinitePairwiseCoverageGap.finite_pairwise_coverage_gap. The result must retain monotonicity, submodularity, unrestricted optimum 4, nonempty pairwise-feasible distributions, the universal pairwise upper bound 479/160, and the strict ratio comparison, over the complete real-valued feasible domain.

interfaces.expected_statement_lean_code:
theorem finite_pairwise_coverage_gap :
    (∀ ⦃s t : Finset Element⦄, s ⊆ t → coverage s ≤ coverage t) ∧
    (∀ s t : Finset Element,
      coverage (s ∪ t) + coverage (s ∩ t) ≤ coverage s + coverage t) ∧
    IsUnrestrictedOptimum 4 ∧
    IsPairwiseUpperBound (479 / 160) ∧
    (4 : ℝ) / (479 / 160) > 4 / 3 := by
  sorry
